name: Discord
label: gg, until server 100
summary: Creating an app and an OAuth install link takes a coffee. The cliff is at 100 servers, where privileged intents change shape. We could read the flags but not the approval process.
verdict: A coffee to set up. The cliff is at 100 servers, and Discord doesn't document what's on the other side of it.
blocker: Past 100 servers, the privileged intents (presence, members, message content) move to a different flag, and we couldn't find what Discord asks to grant them.

steps.title: Create the application in the Developer Portal
steps.detail: The portal's click-path wasn't in the pages we read. This is from how it behaves in practice.

steps.title: Add redirect URIs
steps.detail: An application carries a list of redirect URIs. Add every callback you'll use, per environment.

steps.title: Set install params: scopes and permissions per context
steps.detail: Default install settings are separate for server installs and user installs. Discord's provided install links are limited to the bot and applications.commands scopes.

steps.title: Implement the code exchange
steps.detail: Standard authorization code grant. We didn't fetch Discord's OAuth2 reference, so the details of the exchange are not sourced here.

steps.title: Privileged intents: limited under 100 servers, gated above
steps.detail: Presence, guild members and message content each have a limited flag for bots in fewer than 100 servers and a full flag for 100 or more. What Discord requires to grant the full flag isn't on the page we read.

nuances.text: Only the limited intent flags can be changed through the API.
A flag called VERIFICATION_PENDING_GUILD_LIMIT marks unusual growth that blocks verification.
Install settings are separate for guild installs and user installs.
The server count at which verification becomes required.
nuances.note: The page names 100 for intents. It does not state a verification threshold.

nuances.text: What verification asks for and how long it takes.

blockers.cause: The privileged intent needs the full flag once you pass 100 servers.
blockers.fix: Apply for the intent before you cross the line, not after.

blockers.symptom: Can't get verified despite meeting requirements
blockers.cause: A growth-limit flag is set on the application.
blockers.fix: Contact Discord developer support with your growth history.
